newsitem.title: INDIA: India Tata Chem fall continues on result.
newsitem.headline: India Tata Chem fall continues on result.

text.p: Shares of Tata Chemicals continued to slide, falling 7.50 rupees or 4.15 percent to 173.25 on the Bombay bourse on Friday after disappointing first half results, traders said.

Tata Chemicals shares fell 19.25 rupees to 180.75 on Thursday after the firm said its net profit during the six months to September 30, 1996 fell to 1,319.9 million rupees from 1,751.5 in year ago period.
Provision for taxation during the first half of 1996/97 (April-March) was sharply higher at 447.8 million rupees from 30.0 million in the corresponding period last year.
